warfarin.t: Women who take a warfarin anticoagulant and use a miconazole intravaginal cream or suppository may be at risk for developing an increased prothrombin time, international normalized ratio (INR), and bleeding.
The potential for this interaction between warfarin and miconazole nitrate, zinc oxide and white petrolatum ointment is unknown.

folic acid.t: Pernicious anemia is a contraindication, as folic acid may obscure its signs and symptoms.
Administration of folic acid alone is improper therapy for pernicious anemia and other megaloblastic anemias in which vitamin B12 is deficient.
